title: 第13章  我一眼就看出你不是人
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
陆渊脚下一踏，如离弦之箭追出，一个起落便来到领头的水伥身后。
探手，五指如钩，死死扣住对方后颈。
“唳——”
领头水伥惨叫一声，四肢乱蹬，但根本无法挣脱。
浑身黑毛湿漉漉贴在身上，脑袋上青筋暴起，一双幽黄瞳孔满是恐惧。
“饶命！饶命！”
水伥口吐人言，露出一嘴细密尖牙。
开了灵智的妖魔能说人话，倒也不少见。
“现在知道求饶，早他妈干什么去了？”陆渊冷笑。
“是血妖！是血妖让我这么干的！大人饶命！”水伥缩着身子。
“血妖？”
“是是是......它让我们在北渡口放出气息，将镇魔卫都引过来。”
水伥声音中透着恐惧。
本以为只是做做样子，谁能想到阴沟里翻船了。
这人究竟是谁？
赤霞县的那几个镇魔卫之中可没有这种狠角色。
陆渊目光一凝，好啊，妖魔也会调虎离山，的确是开智了。
“血妖在哪儿？”
“它就藏在东街陈家。”
“为何要引镇魔司的人过来？”

水伥眼瞳一转，缩着脖子，“大人若是肯放条生路，小妖一定知无不言，言无不尽。”
“你他妈还会说成语？”
陆渊冷笑，一枚晶刺从掌心激射，瞬间洞穿水伥头颅。

“做妖就要有做妖的觉悟，学人讲条件，你配吗？”
【夜瞳[白]×34】

“合成。”
面板字迹变化。
【本次合成词条为夜瞳[白]】
【正在合成】

【破妄：看破一切幻法诡藏，洞彻玄机】
【注：同一路径下仅可绑定一个词条】
陆渊绑定【破妄】，望向县城东街方向，淡淡金光在眼底隐现。
原本就打算去一趟陈家的，正好，就现在吧。
一转身，远处传来急促的脚步声，几名身穿墨黑锦袍的衙役正从街道那头狂奔过来。
待他们冲到渡口边缘时，眼前的景象让他们下意识刹住了脚步。
月光下，妖尸遍地，有的断手断脚，有的脑袋爆了，有的被打成了筛子。
地上漂着大片黑血，在月光下泛着诡异的光。

浓烈的血腥味呛得人几乎要呕吐。
陆渊从中走出，月光洒落，映出黑袍上的片片血渍。
几名衙役慌忙镇定心神，躬身行礼。
“校尉大人......”
“收拾一下，妖尸你们自行处理。”
“是！”
陆渊走入黑暗，翻身上马，消失在夜色之中。
几名衙役站在原地，看着满地妖尸，又互相对视一眼，脸上是住不住的惊骇。
这才多久？
三十多只水伥就成了一地妖尸。
这他妈是人能做到的？
几人缩了缩脖子，心底生出一阵惊悚。
这种场面若是若换成他们，只怕被吃得连骨头都不剩了。
......
县城东街，陈家大宅。
夜色如墨，整座宅子没有灯火，没有声响，连一声犬吠都听不见。
苏定安和吴守信来到院墙下，翻身上墙，向内看去。
院子里静悄悄的，空无一人。
两人对视一眼，落入院中。
双脚落地的那一刻，吴守信浑身汗毛都竖了起来。

一种说不清的感觉环绕在身侧，就像是有一双眼睛正在暗处盯着他。
“吴大人？”苏定安见他不动，低声问道。
“没事，进去搜。”吴守信深吸一口气，摇了摇头。
两人摸向后院。
空气中弥漫着若有若无的腥甜气息，像是血。
越往里走，吴守信的心中就越发不安。
苏定安也皱起了眉头。
走过一间厢房，苏定安下意识往窗缝里看了一眼。
又经过一间，还是空的。
再往前是正房，他凑到窗边，屏住呼吸。
透过窗纸，隐约能看到一个人躺在床上。
苏定安心中暗自松了口气，有人就好，有人就正常。
正想离开，却忽然感到一丝不对。
定睛一看，他差点儿瘫在地上。
床上那人，正对着窗户，一双冷漠的眼睛直勾勾地盯着他。
“卧——”
还没骂出口，那人猛地蹿起，向他直扑而来。
吴守信第一时间反应过来，拉着苏定安飞速后退。
那人发出一声嘶吼，踉跄追出。
月光映照下，一个中年男人身穿寝衣，脸色青灰，眼眶里是一片猩红。

在他嘴角两边，露出两颗尖锐獠牙。
苏定安瞬间头皮发麻。
“陈连山？！”
吴守信面露惊愕，腰间横刀瞬间出鞘。
连陈家之主都成了血奴，那整个陈家......
似乎是为了印证他的猜测，周围忽然响起窸窸窣窣的声响。
浓烈的妖气忽然爆发，一道又一道黑影出现在院中，男女老少，十几双猩红的眸子在黑暗中显得极为妖异。
“糟了，我们来晚了，苏大人，撤！”
吴守信惊呼一声，正要撤退，就听耳边传来破风声响，苏定安已经没了踪影。
吴守信脸颊一阵抽动，是了，早在来的路上对方就说了，若是遇到妖魔会第一个撤退。
本以为对方是说笑，没想到来真的。
他纵身跃起，刚要跳过院墙，两只血奴突然从屋顶扑杀下来。
吴守信横刀一挥，斩落两只血奴，同时也错失了逃跑机会。
院子里的血奴如潮水一样涌了过来，吴守信刀光霍霍，每次出手都会在血奴身上砍下狰狞伤口。
但他心里清楚，这样撑不了多久。
血奴数量太多了，没过多久他就会力竭。
更重要的是，血奴的头领陈连山就站在一旁，根本没有出手的意思，像是在看戏一样。
“不愧是镇魔卫啊......”
陈连山瞳孔猩红，笑得诡异，“一只初境血奴根本杀不死他，就算是我上去，恐怕也只能打个平手。”
“可惜，这里并不止一只血奴......”

“杀不死他，可以耗死他。”
旁边一名管家模样的血奴微微点头，突然神情微变。
“家主，那个逃跑的镇魔卫怎么办？万一引来其他镇魔卫......”
“不用担心。”陈连山满不在意地摇头，“血妖大人早有布置，赤霞县的镇魔卫此刻应该正在北渡口戏水。”
“若是那些水伥拦不住镇魔卫呢？”
“就算拦不住，也能拖几个时辰，而血妖大人眼下只需一炷香的时间。”
“一炷香之后，就算镇魔卫赶来，也不过是徒增血食而已。”
说着，陈连山眉头皱起，向院外看去。
“又有人来了？你去应付一下，别让他靠近宅子。”
“是。”
......
管家出了大门，走下台阶，就看到一人一马自街面疾驰而来。
月光之下，来人衣袍翻飞，黑发轻浮。
管家长舒口气，心下大定。
还好，并不是镇魔司的人。
这么想着，黑袍青年已经下马来到近前。
管家连忙走上前去，拱手喊道：
“这位小兄弟，不知——”
话还没说完，一道晶刺突兀袭来。
“我一眼就看出你不是人！”

管家脸色剧变，刚要躲闪，就被刺穿心脏倒在地上。
陆渊眼瞳闪过金光，皂靴踩上管家脑袋。
一脚爆浆。
【击杀凡境血奴，获得白色词条[嗜血]】

Lu Yuan stepped on his foot and chased him like an arrow from a string. He rose and fell behind the leading water turtle.
He reached out and used his five fingers like hooks to clasp the back of the opponent's neck.
"唳——"
The leader screamed and kicked his limbs wildly, but he couldn't break free at all.
The black hair all over his body was wet and clinging to his body, blue veins popped out on his head, and his pair of faint yellow pupils were full of fear.
"Spare your life! Spare your life!"
Shui Yi spoke human words, revealing a mouth of fine fangs.
It is not uncommon for demons who have developed spiritual wisdom to be able to speak human language.
"Now that you know how to beg for mercy, what the hell have you done?" Lu Yuan sneered.
"It's the blood demon! It's the blood demon who asked me to do this! Please forgive me, sir!" Shui Min shrank.
"Blood demon?"
"Yes, yes...it allowed us to release our breath at Beifu and attract all the demon-suppressing guards here."
There was fear in the waterman's voice.
I thought it was just for show, but who would have thought that the boat would capsize in the gutter.
Who is this person?
There is no such ruthless character among the demon-suppressing guards in Chixia County.
Lu Yuan's eyes narrowed, good, the demon can also make the tiger leave the mountain, it is indeed wise.
"Where is the blood demon?"
"It's hidden in Chen's house on East Street."
"Why do you want to lure the people from the Demon Suppression Division here?"
Shui Yi rolled his eyes and shrank his neck, "If the master is willing to find a way out, the little demon will definitely tell you everything he knows."
"Can you fucking still speak idioms?"
Lu Yuan sneered, and a crystal thorn shot out from his palm, instantly piercing the water demon's head.

Lu Yuan bound [Breaking Delirium] and looked towards the east street of the county seat, with a faint golden light looming in his eyes.
I originally planned to go to Chen's house, but it happened to be right now.
As soon as I turned around, I heard the sound of rapid footsteps in the distance, and several government officials wearing jet black brocade robes were running towards me from the other side of the street.
When they rushed to the edge of the ferry, the sight before them stopped them subconsciously.
Under the moonlight, demon corpses were everywhere, some with severed arms and legs, some with exploded heads, and some beaten into sieves.
There was a large amount of black blood floating on the ground, glowing strangely under the moonlight.
The strong smell of blood makes people almost vomit.
Lu Yuan walked out, and the moonlight fell, reflecting the blood stains on the black robe.
Several government officials hurriedly calmed down and bowed.
"Lord Captain..."
"Take care of it. You can deal with the monster corpses on your own."
"Yes!"
Lu Yuan walked into the darkness, got on his horse, and disappeared into the night.
Several government officials stood there, looking at the monster corpses on the ground, and then looking at each other, with uncontrollable horror on their faces.
How long has it been?
More than thirty water jellyfish turned into a pile of monster corpses.
Is this fucking possible for a human to do?
Several people shrank their necks, feeling terrified in their hearts.
If this situation happened to them, they would probably be eaten to the point where no bones would be left.
...
On the east street of the county seat, the Chen family mansion.
The night was dark, and there were no lights or sounds in the whole house, not even a barking dog could be heard.
Su Ding'an and Wu Shouxin came to the courtyard wall, climbed up the wall, and looked inside.
The courtyard was quiet and deserted.
The two looked at each other and fell into the courtyard.
The moment his feet landed on the ground, the hair on Wu Shouxin's body stood up.
An indescribable feeling surrounded him, as if a pair of eyes were staring at him from the dark.
"Master Wu?" Su Ding'an asked in a low voice when he saw that he was not moving.
"fine,Go in and search. "Wu Shouxin took a deep breath and shook his head.
The two of them walked towards the backyard.
The air was filled with a faint fishy-sweet smell, like blood.
The further they walked in, the more uneasy Wu Shouxin felt.
Su Ding'an also frowned.
After passing a wing room, Su Ding'an subconsciously glanced through the crack in the window.
I passed another room, still empty.
Further forward was the main room. He leaned to the window and held his breath.
Through the window paper, you can vaguely see a person lying on the bed.
Su Ding'an secretly breathed a sigh of relief. It's okay if there are people, and it's normal if there are people.
Just as he was about to leave, he suddenly felt something was wrong.
Looking closely, he almost collapsed on the ground.
The man on the bed was facing the window, staring straight at him with a pair of cold eyes.
"Lie——"
Before he could curse, the man suddenly jumped up and rushed towards him.
Wu Shouxin reacted immediately and pulled Su Ding'an back quickly.
The man roared and staggered out.
Under the moonlight, a middle-aged man was wearing pajamas, his face was gray and his eyes were scarlet.
On both sides of his mouth, two sharp fangs were exposed.
Su Ding'an's scalp went numb instantly.
"Chen Lianshan? ! "
Wu Shouxin looked shocked, and the sword on his waist was instantly unsheathed.
Even the head of the Chen family has become a blood slave, then the entire Chen family...
As if to confirm his guess, there was a sudden rustling sound all around.
The strong demonic energy suddenly erupted, and black shadows appeared in the courtyard one after another. Men, women, and children, with more than a dozen pairs of scarlet eyes, looked extremely evil in the darkness.
"Oops, we're late, Master Su, retreat! "
Wu Shouxin exclaimed and was about to retreat when he heard the sound of breaking wind in his ears and Su Ding'an had disappeared.
Wu Shouxin's cheeks twitched. Yes, the other party had already said on the way here that he would be the first to retreat if he encountered a demon.
I thought the other party was joking, but I didn't expect it to be serious.
He jumped up and was about to jump over the courtyard wall when two blood slaves suddenly rushed down from the roof.
Wu Shouxin swung his sword horizontally and killed two blood slaves, but also missed the opportunity to escape.
The blood slaves in the yard rushed over like a tide. Wu Shouxin's sword flashed brightly, and every time he struck, he would cut hideous wounds on the blood slaves.
But he knew in his heart that he wouldn't last long.
There are too many blood slaves, and it won't be long before he is exhausted.
More importantly, the leader of the blood slaves, Chen Lianshan, was standing aside with no intention of taking action, as if he was watching a show.
"As expected of the Demon Suppressing Guard..."
Chen Lianshan's pupils were scarlet and he smiled strangely, "A first-level blood slave can't kill him at all. Even if I go up, I'm afraid I can only fight in a draw. "
"Unfortunately, there is more than one blood slave here..."
“If you can’t kill him, you can consume him to death. "
The blood slave who looked like a butler next to him nodded slightly, and his expression suddenly changed slightly.
"Master, what should I do with the escaped demon-suppressing guard? If other demon-suppressing guards are attracted..."
"Don't worry. "Chen Lianshan shook his head nonchalantly, "Lord Blood Demon has already made arrangements. The demon-suppressing guards from Chixia County should be playing in the water at Beidakou at the moment. "
"What if those water minions can't stop the demon-suppressing guards? "
"Even if it can't be stopped, it can still be delayed for a few hours, and Lord Blood Demon only needs a stick of incense at the moment. "
"After one stick of incense, even if the demon-suppressing guards arrive, it will only increase the blood supply. "
As he spoke, Chen Lianshan frowned and looked outside the hospital.
"Is someone coming again? You go deal with it and don't let him get close to the house. "
"yes. "
...
The housekeeper walked out of the door and walked down the steps, and saw a man and a horse galloping down the street.
Under the moonlight, the visitor's robes were flying, and his black hair was frivolous.
The housekeeper breathed a sigh of relief and felt reassured.
Fortunately, he is not from the Demon Suppressing Division.
With this thought in mind, the young man in black robe dismounted and came closer.
The housekeeper hurriedly stepped forward and held his handshouted:
“This little brother, I don’t know——”
Before he finished speaking, a crystal thorn suddenly struck him.
"I can tell at a glance that you are not human!"
The butler's expression changed drastically. Just as he was about to dodge, he was stabbed in the heart and fell to the ground.
Lu Yuan's eyes flashed with golden light, and his soap boots stepped on the butler's head.
One kick explodes.
